title: Time-to-hire cut 48%, with $200,000+ in supplier fee savings.
summary: A multinational manufacturer partners to redesign its talent acquisition, establishing a scalable, data-driven framework for effective hiring and reduced costs.
body_markdown:
- **Company/Industry**
A global communications and public safety technology company.
- **Challenge**
Roughly $5 million in contingent spend bypassed the MSP program as hiring managers sought faster talent sourcing.
- **Solution**
KellyOCG® optimized the supplier pool, brought spend back into the program, and added payroll consolidation and AI-powered rate benchmarking.
- **Result**
Time-to-hire fell from 40 to 21 days; hiring manager satisfaction rose from 5.6 to 8.9 out of 10; more than $200,000 in supplier fee savings.


## Challenge: off-program spend, slower talent access, and weakened governance.


For 18 years, KellyOCG served as the[managed service provider (MSP)](https://www.kellyservices.com/divisions/outsourcing-consulting-group/expertise/external-workforce/) for a global communications and public safety technology company in APAC. We identified approximately $5 million in contingent spend outside the program. Hiring managers were sourcing directly, believing it was faster and cheaper. Because the work supported projects requiring stringent background checks, procurement couldn't capture the full value of a centrally managed program. The goal was to restore governance without straining the relationship — and prove it delivers more than compliance.


## Solution: a faster supplier pool, smarter procurement, and recovered spend.


KellyOCG first optimized the supplier pool, so qualified candidates arrived quickly, removing the main reason managers went off program. Most of the rogue spend then returned to the MSP. We also modernized regional procurement and:


- **Payroll:** A unified service across Australia, Singapore, and Malaysia was adopted.
- **Direct sourcing:** KellyOCG joined the supplier panel, adding speed and annual savings.
- **Benchmarking:** An AI-powered market rate tool replaced a one-month turnaround with instant reports.


## Results: faster hiring, higher satisfaction, and measurable savings.


Time-to-hire decreased 48%, from 40 days to 21; hiring manager satisfaction climbed from 5.6 to 8.9 out of 10; and supplier fee savings reached over $200,000. AI benchmarking also cut the cost per report by 40%, giving managers confidence they pay true market rate. Governance and speed proved compatible, and the partnership continues to exceed cost-savings targets.
